description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled nursing professional to contribute to a supportive environment focused on delivering high-quality patient care. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in overseeing nursing operations and ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards.

As an ADON, you will assist the Director of Nursing in managing the nursing department, supervising staff, and maintaining exceptional standards of care. We are particularly interested in candidates who are Registered Nurses (RNs) to help lead our team and uphold our commitment to clinical excellence. This role offers a chance to make a significant impact on the lives of our residents and the professional development of our nursing staff.

This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications. If you are a motivated leader with a passion for geriatric care and a desire to advance your career, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Prior leadership or supervisory experience in a healthcare setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations

description: Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Red Bay, AL, as a Full-time Housekeeper. In this vital role, you will be responsible for maintaining a clean, sanitary, and comfortable environment for our residents, staff, and visitors. Your commitment to cleanliness directly contributes to the health, safety, and well-being of everyone in our community.We are seeking a meticulous and reliable individual to ensure our facility upholds the highest standards of hygiene. This full-time position offers the opportunity to be an integral part of a compassionate care team, providing essential support services that enhance the quality of life for our residents. If you are passionate about creating a pristine and welcoming atmosphere, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Previous experience in housekeeping, preferably in a healthcare setting
Ability to follow cleaning schedules and protocols
Strong attention to detail and commitment to cleanliness
Ability to perform physical tasks such as lifting, bending, and standing for extended periods
